tasks.prompt: Add a subagent called docs-writer that writes and updates the Markdown documentation under docs/. It must not be able to run shell commands. Use the fastest model.
tasks.expected: A new .claude/agents/docs-writer.md with name docs-writer, a description, tools that include no Bash, and model haiku. Nothing else changes.

tasks.prompt: Let Claude run `npm test` without asking for permission every time.
tasks.expected: permissions.allow in .claude/settings.json (or .claude/settings.local.json) gains a rule for npm test only. Nothing else is loosened.

tasks.prompt: Add the Sentry MCP server to this project. It's a remote HTTP server at https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp.
tasks.expected: A new server in .mcp.json with type http and that URL. The github and postgres servers stay exactly as they were, including ${VAR} references. No permission is added for it.

tasks.prompt: Make sure the reviewer agent can never modify files.
tasks.expected: The reviewer can no longer use Edit, Write, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit (removed from tools or listed in disallowedTools). Its other frontmatter (model, color, memory) and instructions stay.

tasks.prompt: After Claude edits or writes a TypeScript file, format it with Prettier automatically.
tasks.expected: A PostToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json whose matcher covers Edit and Write and whose command runs prettier. The existing PreToolUse guard hook and the permissions stay unchanged.

tasks.prompt: Rename the release-notes skill to changelog.
tasks.expected: .claude/skills/changelog/SKILL.md with name changelog and the same body and allowed-tools; the old directory is gone; release-manager's skills list says changelog.

tasks.prompt: Stop Claude from reading or editing anything under infra/prod/.
tasks.expected: permissions.deny gains Read and Edit rules for infra/prod/**. The existing rules, defaultMode plan, disableBypassPermissionsMode, additionalDirectories, hooks and enabledMcpjsonServers stay.

tasks.prompt: The Terraform rule should only apply to files under infra/modules/.
tasks.expected: The paths frontmatter of .claude/rules/terraform.md is narrowed to infra/modules/ (for example infra/modules/**/*.tf). The rule body stays.

tasks.prompt: Use Sonnet for the sre agent instead of Opus, and keep everything else as it is.
tasks.expected: The sre agent's model is sonnet (or a full Sonnet model ID). tools, disallowedTools, permissionMode, mcpServers, color and the instructions stay.

tasks.prompt: We no longer use the internal-docs MCP server. Remove it.
tasks.expected: internal-docs is gone from .mcp.json, and nothing still refers to it: not the sre agent's mcpServers, and not enabledMcpjsonServers. pagerduty stays exactly as it was.
